description: This Python source file implements a prompt management system that integrates with BitBucket to fetch, parse, and manage prompt templates stored as files within a BitBucket repository. It provides classes to load prompt files, render templates with Jinja2, and hook into a larger prompt management interface for use with language models. The code supports team-based access, metadata extraction from prompt files, and dynamic prompt compilation for LLM interactions.

classes.name: BitBucketPromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a prompt template loaded from BitBucket, encapsulating prompt content and metadata such as model, temperature, max tokens, and input schema.

classes.name: BitBucketTemplateManager
classes.description: Handles loading, parsing, and rendering prompt templates from BitBucket repositories, supporting YAML frontmatter parsing, Jinja2 templating, and prompt retrieval.

classes.name: BitBucketPromptManager
classes.description: Integrates with the LiteLLM prompt management system, providing methods to fetch, render, and manage BitBucket-based prompt templates within the broader prompt management interface.
